Items: yogurt drink (~150g, strawberry, ~130 kcal), orange juice (~250ml, 110 kcal), coffee small (~100g, ~20 kcal with milk), English muffin with ham and cheese (~150g, ~330 kcal), 5 slices toast (~35g each = 175g, ~460 kcal), 4 butter portions (~10g each = 40g, ~290 kcal), 6 jam portions (~15g each... say 6x14 = 84g, ~210 kcal), water excluded.

Total kcal ≈ 130+110+20+330+460+290+210 = 1550.
Mass ≈ 150+250+100+150+175+40+84 = 949.
